message: an ICU's case draws a tag at offset 756 (`<span class="pct-pair__more" [it's]="more()" tabindex="0">
$reason: `stop-in-an-icu` with a bracketed name holding an apostrophe before the stop's `tabindex`, `[it's]`. Angular's lexer reads a bracketed name up to its closing bracket, quotes included, and the template parses with no error; the tag scan opens a quote at the apostrophe that nothing after it closes, and finds no tag where the stop starts. Outside an ICU the tree's tag offsets against the scan's refuse such a tag, one the tree holds at an offset where the scan found none; inside one the tree holds no element, and so no offset to hold the scan to, and the template passed, as it does on main, with `[a"b]` as well. The HTML tree places each tag a case draws (`cased`), and one the scan never found fails point 1.
